query: According to the Mamba paper, what inference throughput advantage over Transformers is stated in its abstract?
answer:
Mamba 摘要及正文称其推理吞吐量比 Transformer 高 5 倍（5× higher throughput than Transformers）[12][14]。正文另表述为比规模相近的 Transformer 高 4–5 倍（4-5× higher inference throughput than a Transformer of similar size）[13]。

来源：
[12] 2312.00752v2.pdf，p.1；[固定版本PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.00752v2)
[13] 2312.00752v2.pdf，p.15；[固定版本PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.00752v2)
[14] 2312.00752v2.pdf，p.15；[固定版本PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.00752v2)
